run_adsorption_relaxation: run AdsorptionRunner to relax adsorbate plus surface configurations and compute adsorption energy
calculate_adsorption_energy: calculate adsorption energy by relaxing atoms with LBFGS optimizer and a force convergence threshold
write_adsorption_results: write adsorption calculation results to a compressed JSON file in the results directory
initialize_adsorption_runner: initialize an AdsorptionRunner with a calculator, input data, and optional surface relaxation settings
chunk_adsorption_jobs: split adsorption relaxation jobs across multiple workers using job_num and num_jobs parameters
